prompt_used:
You are given a 60 seconds (at most) video clip of an autonomous driving test. Please analyze it and identify any interesting driving events. 
For each event, include the timestamp of the event (in seconds), a 50 words description, the event type, and whether the driver intervened/disengaged.
Intervened/Disengaged is when the driver assists the autonomous system, or takes over the control of the vehicle.
Note the driver might discuss about a previous issue, but it's not an event. You should ONLY include events that are happening in the video clip.
Also, since the video cannot be longer than 60 seconds, the timestamp should be between [0, 60].
...

results.description: The autonomous system attempts a U-turn but fails to make the radius, forcing itself into a three-point turn scenario. The driver expresses concern about this behavior, especially on high-speed roads, as it could lead to dangerous situations where other cars have to wait.

The autonomous vehicle is making multiple turns to position itself for a U-turn. It is performing rapid decision-making and three-point turns to get the correct angle. The system is working to navigate the situation without driver intervention, although it is causing other cars to wait.

The car is in drive, but the driver thinks it needs to back up to avoid the curb. The car then goes into reverse and gives itself a little bit of room. The driver thinks it should have gone back further.
The car is trying to avoid the curb, but it is not going back far enough. The driver is getting frustrated and says, "Oh, you gotta be kidding me."
The car is continuing to try to avoid the curb. The driver is impressed that the car is continuing to try, even though it is not going to go. The car is in drive now.

The driver taps the accelerator pedal to encourage the car to move forward during a parking maneuver. The driver felt the car was too close to the curb and wanted to move it slightly further away. The driver describes it as a 'pedal of encouragement'.
The car approaches a stop sign and slows down to stop. The driver says 'Don't go there' indicating the car might have proceeded without stopping. The car stops at the stop sign.
The car makes a right turn and accelerates smoothly. The driver comments on the good acceleration. The car accelerates from 15 mph to 45 mph in a short amount of time.

The driver disengages Autopilot. The driver mentions that he jammed the car at a funny angle to test the three-point turn maneuver. The car is now in drive mode and the driver is going to test the car's ability to navigate the cul-de-sac.

The car is driving on a two-lane road. The car is pulling forward and doing okay without a heat map. The car is going to the end of the cul-de-sac and following the U-turn around. The car did not need to reverse.

The car is driving cautiously and it doesn't have the road mapped. The vision is doing this on its own. The radius of the turn was just fine all the way around. The car is getting really good in the Model Y.

The car approaches a stop sign and comes to a complete stop. The driver notes that the car will need to creep forward after stopping due to limited visibility. The car then creeps forward to get a better view of the cross street.

The car is at an intersection and needs to turn left. There is traffic coming from both directions. The car waits for a gap in traffic and then proceeds to turn left, going into the median to complete the turn safely.

The driver notices a message on the screen indicating that FSD may be degraded. The driver is unsure why this message appeared, but it suggests a potential issue with the autonomous driving system's performance or reliability.

The autonomous system decelerates for a U-turn, causing a car behind to also decelerate. The driver notes the system is in chill mode, which may affect its responsiveness. The car slows down to 0 mph to make the U-turn.

The autonomous system waits before making a U-turn, which the driver finds cautious. The driver expected the system to proceed more quickly. The driver is considering switching to hurry mode to see if it makes the system more aggressive.

The autonomous system is waiting to make a U-turn. The driver observes a small gap in traffic followed by a larger gap. The driver doesn't think the system will go for the small gap, and is waiting for the larger gap to form.

The vehicle is navigating a curve in the road. The driver is observing the vehicle's performance and notes that it is handling the curve smoothly and accurately. The driver is impressed with the vehicle's ability to maintain a consistent speed and trajectory through the curve.

The car is driving on a bridge. The car is driving smoothly and the system is working well. The car is staying in its lane and maintaining a safe distance from other vehicles. The system is also correctly identifying the road conditions.

The car is approaching railroad tracks. The driver is expecting a deceleration as the car crosses the tracks. The driver is observing the car's behavior to see if there is any different behavior there.

The car suddenly steered to avoid something on the road. The driver was looking at the screen and didn't see anything, but the car acted like it was going around something at the last second. The driver did not intervene.

The car successfully detected and slowed down for a speed bump. The driver mentioned that the car sometimes misses this speed bump, but it correctly identified it and adjusted the speed this time. The driver did not intervene.
The car aggressively brakes for a speed bump once it sees it. The driver finds it interesting because the car has missed the speed bump in the past. The car slows down from 20 mph to 14 mph.
The car is using the suicide lane and slows down to 9 mph. The driver thinks it's almost too slow, and he is comfortable with 10 or 11 mph on those lanes.
The car approaches an unprotected left turn with a suicide lane. The driver is not clear to the right, so he is waiting to see if the car will go into the suicide lane.

The autonomous driving system successfully navigates an intersection without using the suicide lane, demonstrating improved decision-making in route selection. The system proceeds straight across the intersection, avoiding the suicide lane, as both directions are clear of traffic.

The car initiates a lane change to the right, potentially due to the route planning. The driver observes that the lane change might have been pre-planned for the destination, and they are approaching a right turn, which makes it interesting to watch the lane selection.

The vehicle is approaching a green light and making a right turn. The driver notes that the turn is smooth and the vehicle did not slow down too much. The driver is impressed with the autonomous system's performance during this turn.

The vehicle is approaching a yellow light and stops appropriately. The driver notes that the autonomous system made a good decision to stop for the yellow light, indicating proper sign and light compliance.

The autonomous system is taking a corner off of a high-speed road at a faster speed than before. The driver finds this encouraging, as slowing down too much on high-speed roads can be dangerous if other drivers are not paying attention.

The driver is curious if others with the same version of the software have noticed the same behavior. He thinks it's a good behavior that has snuck in there. The car is approaching an intersection and slowing down.

The driver notices a message on the screen indicating that the full self-driving capability may be degraded. This is the first time the driver has seen this message during the current test drive. The driver expresses confusion about the reason for the degradation.

The driver notices a message on the screen indicating that the full self-driving capability may be degraded. This is the second time the driver has seen this message during the current test drive. The driver expresses confusion about the reason for the degradation.

The car is approaching a supercharger location. The driver is curious to see if the car will back into a charging spot automatically. The car slows down as it approaches the charging area, but it does not initiate a backing maneuver.

The Tesla FSD system failed to initiate driving at the intersection. The driver expressed encouragement, but the system remained stationary. The driver had to manually re-engage the system to continue the autonomous driving test.

The autonomous vehicle approaches a red light with a pedestrian holding a sign on the sidewalk. The driver notes that the car should creep and go, but the light turns green, resulting in a protected scenario. The car proceeds through the intersection without issue.

The driver is playing with the screen to adjust the route. The driver mentions that the "pay attention to the road" warning has tightened up a little bit, and he feels like he's getting busted a little bit more than the last version.

The vehicle is in the right lane, and the driver is wondering if it will stay in the right lane or immediately jump over. The vehicle uses the blinker and immediately jumps over to the left lane. The vehicle shows good acceleration here.

The autonomous driving system is driving at 78 mph in a 65 mph zone. The driver notes that the car is not passing other vehicles, and other vehicles are passing it. The driver is in the right lane and feels like the car is hurrying.

The car is getting out of the lane because it's starting to slow down. The driver modified the route a little bit. The car jumped out of that lane once the driver modified the route to get onto Interstate 10.

The vehicle is getting into the right lane in preparation for a turn. The driver mentions that the vehicle has had issues with the gore section in the past, but it is doing well this time. The vehicle is driving at 70 mph.

The vehicle is experiencing progressive lane drift, and the driver mentions hearing the tires hit the reflectors a few times. The driver is discussing the lane drifting issue and wondering what could be causing it.
The vehicle aggressively changes into the left lane to keep moving. The driver comments that the lane change felt like an LA lane change, indicating it was a quick and assertive maneuver.

The car is driving close to the left edge of the lane and hits the reflectors while passing another car. The driver explains that the car was giving the other car some room as it was navigating a turn at the same time.

The car is doing an interchange and then jumping off with an off-ramp down into the Memorial Park section. The car is driving smoothly and following the lane markings. The speed is appropriate for the highway. The driver is not intervening.

The driver is impressed with how well the car is handling this intersection. He mentions that in the past, the car would slow down to 45 mph, and other cars would be whizzing around it. Now, the car is doing 70 mph with the flow of traffic.
